description: Retrieves weekly, paginated analytics data on variable insertions and detachments for a specified Figma library (identified by `file_key`), groupable by 'variable' or 'team', and filterable by an optional date range. Note: Requires Enterprise plan and library_analytics:read scope.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination from a previous response; omit or use null for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the analytics range. Data is aggregated weekly; this date rounds to the nearest week end. Defaults to the latest computed week if unspecified.
end_date.title: End Date

file_key.description: Unique identifier (key) of the Figma file (library) for which to retrieve variable analytics data.
file_key.title: File Key

group_by.description: Dimension to group analytics data, which determines the structure of `rows` in the response.
group_by.title: Group By

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the analytics range. Data is aggregated weekly; this date rounds to the nearest week start. Defaults to one year prior if unspecified.
start_date.title: Start Date

name: get_library_analytics_variable_action_data

data.description: Structured response with paginated library analytics data for variable actions.
data.title: Data

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; present only if `next_page` is true.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_page.description: Indicates if more data is available; if true, a `cursor` is provided for the next page.
next_page.title: Next Page

rows.description: Array of analytics data, structured by the `group_by` request parameter: 'variable' for variable-specific metrics, 'team' for team-specific metrics.
rows.title: Rows

collection_key.description: Unique and stable identifier of the variable's collection.
collection_key.title: Collection Key

detachments.description: Total detach events for this variable this week.
detachments.title: Detachments

insertions.description: Total insertion events for this variable this week.
insertions.title: Insertions

variable_key.description: Unique and stable identifier of the variable.
variable_key.title: Variable Key

week.description: Start date of the week for this data point (YYYY-MM-DD).
week.title: Week

detachments.description: Total detach events by this team this week.
detachments.title: Detachments

insertions.description: Total insertion events by this team this week.
insertions.title: Insertions

team_name.description: Name of the team that used library variables.
team_name.title: Team Name

week.description: Start date of the week for this data point (YYYY-MM-DD).
week.title: Week

workspace_name.description: Name of the team's workspace; may be null.
workspace_name.title: Workspace Name
